comparison.objective: Safely assemble a grinding wheel stack on a spindle and verify adequate, non-damaging clamping.
comparison.physical_skill: Ordered coaxial placement of flanges, blotters and wheel, nut tightening and torque-sensitive verification, not loose-body sifting.
comparison.success_condition: Correct undamaged wheel and stack, seated nut below the damage limit, successful braked spin and axial tug, hands clear. Candidate instead scores recovery ratio, retained washers and reseated screen dwell. No material rubric details are missing.
comparison.reason: The task tests safety-critical serial assembly and torque/clamp control; generic alignment and release do not make it overlap with selective separation.
